scripts.purpose: 验证 real runtime BTC source init/feed/cache/context 链路与 ready 可达性
scripts.pass_condition: source_chain_pass=true 且 real_runtime_ready_reached=true 且 btc_price_chain_pass=true

scripts.purpose: 验证 context 字段真值链（running/stopped 语义与 bounds 公式一致性）
scripts.pass_condition: context_truth_pass=true 且 btc_price_chain_pass=true 且 bounds_consistency_pass!=false

scripts.purpose: 验证窗口生命周期、stop_reason、running exclusion、readiness consistency、decision gating
scripts.pass_condition: window_state_semantics_pass=true 且 stop_reason_pass=true 且 running_window_exclusion_pass=true 且 readiness_consistency_pass=true 且 decision_gating_pass=true

scripts.purpose: 验证执行层幂等、窗口隔离、filled_total 真值链
scripts.pass_condition: executor_idempotency_pass=true 且 window_isolation_pass=true 且 filled_total_chain_pass=true

scripts.purpose: 验证 summary / last_run_snapshot / postmortem / performance 的结果链一致性
scripts.pass_condition: filled_total==unique_filled_order_id_count 且 last_run==summary 且 postmortem==summary 且 performance_target_window==summary

scripts.purpose: 验证当前窗口/上一窗口订单归属纯净与 OPEN/FILLED/CANCELLED 状态语义
scripts.pass_condition: window_isolation_pass=true 且 order_status_semantics_pass=true 且 cross_window_overlap_pass=true
